title: InfiniteHits with transformItems broken when using createInstantSearchRouterNext
explanation: This GitHub issue describes a technical problem with the 'InfiniteHits' component in the 'react-instantsearch' library when used with the 'createInstantSearchRouterNext' feature. The issue indicates that the expected behavior is not being observed, with items being removed after being briefly visible when using the 'transformItems' functionality. This suggests a frustrating technical issue that is causing confusion for the user.
